arrays:
📦 Array is a collection of elements stored in contiguous memory. 
🔹 All elements are of the same data type. 
🔹 Each element can be accessed using an index (starting from 0). 
🔹 Arrays allow fast access (O(1)) but insertion/deletion can be costly. 
🚀 Common operations include traversal, insertion, deletion, and searching.
strings:
🔤 String is a sequence of characters. 
🔹 Strings can be immutable (like in Python) or mutable depending on the language. 
🔹 Each character has an index. 
🔹 Common operations include concatenation, slicing, searching, and comparison. 
✨ Strings are widely used in text processing and pattern matching.
